summary: Frontend-only verification of guarded mobile-number (Phone OTP) login on /login. Verified two tabs render, credentials tab is default and interactive, mobile tab shows guarded note (login-phone-note) with no phone input/send button since REACT_APP_ENABLE_PHONE_LOGIN is not set, tab switching works both ways, and /signup regression is intact. Firebase RecaptchaVerifier/signInWithPhoneNumber imports do not break the bundle (0 console errors).
critical_code_review_comments: Auth.jsx imports CheckCircle/WarningCircle only used in Account(); minor lint noise, not a bug.
recaptchaRef is created lazily but never cleared. When phone-login is later enabled, add recaptchaRef.current?.clear() on logout/unmount to avoid stale invisible widgets across sessions.

Defence-in-depth is good: phoneErr handles 'phone/disabled' AND startPhoneLogin throws { code: 'phone/disabled' } before touching Firebase, so even if the UI guard were bypassed the SDK would never be called.
test_credentials: not required (UI-render + tab-behavior only, no auth attempted)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guarded phone-login feature verified with flag OFF. When REACT_APP_ENABLE_PHONE_LOGIN=true is later set (post-Blaze), re-test: (1) mobile tab renders login-phone-input + login-phone-send instead of login-phone-note, (2) OTP verify flow via login-phone-otp/login-phone-verify, (3) #recaptcha-container mounts without CSP/domain errors on preview URL.
